replies.author: cinammoncroc000
replies.body:
Could you provide pictures showcasing the map in daylight? (Unless this map was supposed to be played in the night, in which case it's fine.)

The map looks very nice and, even with Para's rules about the terrain, it looks very comfortable to PvP on! The trees are placed so it provides enough cover without being too dense, and the structures look very nice and blend in well with the overall map.

+1 c: Great job as always!
